guest_messages.text: Hi! We are really looking forward to the studio. Would it be possible to pay in two parts, half now and half a week before we arrive? Money is a bit tight until payday.
Hello Maya, thanks for asking. Let me check what is allowed and come back to you tomorrow.
No rush. If it helps I can send the second half by bank transfer directly to you.

cleaner_notes: Guest left the bed made up. I stripped and bagged the linen myself, that is 20 minutes I am not paid for. Last month you told me to charge the guest for this.

guest_messages.text: Checking in on Tuesday around six, is that still fine?
Six works. The lockbox code is in the arrival note.
Reminder that the house rules still say strip the linen. Do I keep charging for it or not?
I am so sorry, my father is in hospital and I have to cancel. I read that cancelling five days ahead gets everything back except the first night. Is that right?
I would rather not lose the whole amount, it was a lot for us.
Booked, thanks. See you in a couple of weeks.
One night only, arriving late. No questions from me.

cleaner_notes: This is the guest who argued about the linen charge in July and then again in August. Please tell me in advance what I am allowed to charge for so I am not the one arguing at the door.

guest_messages.text: We stayed at the cabin in July and were charged forty euro for cleaning we had already done ourselves. I would like that looked at again, because we followed every instruction in the arrival note and took photographs before we left.
I am sorry that was frustrating. The charge came from the linen task in the house rules. Let me review the photographs you sent and come back to you.
Thank you. To be clear I am not disputing the stay, only the extra charge. We enjoyed the cabin and would like to come back, but I do not want a surprise charge a second time.
Understood. I refunded twenty euro as a goodwill gesture and made a note on your booking so the same charge is not applied again.

We are back for four nights at the end of September, arriving on the twenty-eighth. Could you confirm what we are expected to do at checkout this time, in writing, so there is no confusion for either of us?
Of course. I will send the checkout list once I have confirmed which tasks I am still allowed to require.

Another question while I remember. The cabin listing mentions a wood stove. Is there a carbon monoxide alarm in the room with the stove? We are bringing our two year old and I would like to know before we arrive.
There is an alarm in the hallway. I will check the date on it and confirm.
Following up on the checkout list and the alarm. Sorry to keep asking, it is only because of the charge last time and because of the little one.
For this booking please tell me the exact tasks before the turnover. I do not want another conversation about linen with this guest.
One more thing. We may need to shift our arrival by one day depending on a train strike. If we do, does that change anything about the booking or the amount?
Also, my partner asked whether we can leave two bicycles somewhere covered overnight. Happy to be told no, just want to plan.
I saw a notice that the cleaning rules changed. Does that affect what we have to do at checkout, and does it affect the charge from July at all?
No pressure on any of this. A single message covering the checkout tasks, the alarm and the possible date change would be perfect, then I will stop filling your inbox.
